title: Colonial Raptor (Battlestar Galactica, 2004)
intro: The Raptor is a fictional two-crew utility craft in Battlestar Galactica (2004), used for scouting, transport and rescue, with its own FTL (faster-than-light) drive. The pilot sits up front with stick and throttle; behind sits the ECO, the electronic countermeasures officer, at the sensor and jamming station. A cabin for passengers or cargo follows behind.

areas.name: Pilot's instrument panel
areas.text: Flight displays in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Pilot's instrument panel
panels.text: Screens in front of the pilot for flying and for the DRADIS.
panels.context: The pilot flies while the ECO handles sensors and jumps.

controls.name: Flight displays
controls.text: Screens show the speed, the attitude (whether the nose is up or down and the wings level) and the fuel.
controls.context: The pilot needs them when flying through clouds or space without a horizon.

controls.name: DRADIS
controls.text: The DRADIS, the series' word for radar, shows other ships around the Raptor.
controls.context: It warns of Cylon ships and shows friends.

areas.name: ECO station and cabin
areas.text: The ECO's station behind the pilot and the cabin.

panels.name: ECO station
panels.text: The station of the electronic countermeasures officer behind the pilot.
panels.context: The ECO jams enemy sensors, watches the long-range sensors and plots the jumps.

controls.name: ECM and sensors console
controls.text: A console for jamming (blinding enemy sensors with radio noise) and for long-range sensing.
controls.context: Raptors scout ahead of the fleet, so their sensors are important.

controls.name: FTL jump controls
controls.text: These controls spin up the FTL drive and make the jump once the destination is plotted.
controls.context: FTL lets the Raptor jump far away in an instant; it is how Raptors escape or scout distant places.

controls.name: Jump plot
controls.text: A display of the coordinates worked out before a jump.
controls.context: The jump can only happen after the plot is done.

panels.name: Passenger / cargo compartment
panels.text: The bay behind the cockpit for people or cargo.
panels.context: Raptors carry troops, survivors or supplies.

controls.name: Seats
controls.text: Seats in the cabin for troops or survivors.
controls.context: Rescue missions bring survivors back to the fleet in this cabin.

controls.name: Side hatch
controls.text: A boarding hatch on the side of the Raptor.
controls.context: People climb in and out through it when the Raptor has landed.

areas.name: Stick and throttle
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight stick
panels.text: The flight stick in front of the Raptor pilot's seat.
panels.context: It steers the Raptor in space and in the air.

controls.name: Flight stick
controls.text: Pushing the stick forward or pulling it back tips the nose down or up; moving it left or right rolls the Raptor.
controls.context: The pilot flies with the right hand on the stick.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: The throttle lever at the Raptor pilot's left hand.
panels.context: It sets how hard the Raptor's engines push.

controls.name: Throttle
controls.text: Pushing the lever forward gives more thrust, pulling it back gives less.
controls.context: The left hand sets the speed while the right hand steers.
